evidence.source: GPT Image 2 model page and fixed snapshot: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-image-2
Image generation guide for generation, editing, masks, reference limits, fidelity, output controls, and cost calculation: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation

Official training-data summary provides categories rather than a model-specific licensed-source inventory and includes copyrighted material: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001044-training-data-summary-pursuant-to-california-civil-code-section-3111.jar

Evaluation approval is limited to the committed project-authored synthetic fixtures; customer content is excluded. Input-rights obligations are recorded in the OpenAI Services Agreement: https://cdn.openai.com/osa/openai-services-agreement.pdf

API data controls: image generation/edit endpoints have no application-state retention, default abuse-monitoring retention up to 30 days, and Zero Data Retention eligibility subject to documented exceptions: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/your-data

blockers: The public training-data disclosure is category-level and does not provide a model-specific licensed-source inventory; human legal/product review must decide whether that satisfies VOXL's dataset-provenance requirement before admission or any API call.
